stem.text: How does the antibiotic penicillin affect the metabolism of a bacterial cell?

A.text: Penicillin reduces cell growth by preventing water uptake.

B.text: Penicillin inhibits the formation of cross-links in the cell wall between peptidoglycan molecules.

C.text: Penicillin inhibits the hydrolysis of peptidoglycan links in the cell wall during cell extension.

D.text: Penicillin weakens the cell wall by digesting peptidoglycan molecules.
